WITH date_dim_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1189 + 11
),
store_sales_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
),
catalog_sales_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
),
web_sales_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim_filtered ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim_filtered.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk, date_dim_filtered.d_date
),
store_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, store_sales_dates.d_date
    FROM store_sales_dates
    JOIN customer ON store_sales_dates.ss_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, store_sales_dates.d_date
),
catalog_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, catalog_sales_dates.d_date
    FROM catalog_sales_dates
    JOIN customer ON catalog_sales_dates.cs_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, catalog_sales_dates.d_date
),
web_channel AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, web_sales_dates.d_date
    FROM web_sales_dates
    JOIN customer ON web_sales_dates.ws_bill_customer_sk = customer.c_customer_sk
    GROUP BY customer.c_last_name, customer.c_first_name, web_sales_dates.d_date
),
all_channels AS (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM store_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM catalog_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date FROM web_channel
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM all_channels
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
